status: serialized-caller correctness checkpoint; full application/durability/performance release gates remain pending

contract.public_sal_session: libraries/sal/include/sal/allocator.hpp:158-161 explicitly permits serialized cross-thread use; allocator_session.hpp:431-438 intentionally retires thread identity checks because only concurrent active use is forbidden.
contract.enforcement: One recursive mutex gates every native engine/session/cursor/snapshot operation and native retained-handle destruction. Debug builds assert only one OS thread is active; recursion is limited to native ownership cleanup. No application callbacks are invoked under this boundary.
contract.lifetime: Opaque shared roots and session views retain State until synchronous native operations and native destruction finish. Last owner can close from any caller after the gate, with no worker self-join or retained TLS native session.
contract.cpu: Native storage now runs on its original caller and is billed by the real caller CPU clock. Mutex waits consume no thread CPU. Offloaded CPU helper remains independently qualified; storage no longer creates offloaded jobs. Cancellation is checked before waiting and again after acquiring the native gate.
contract.publication: Logical view lock spans native publication and cached manifest assignment so concurrent publishers have the same persistent/cache order. Existing high-level OCC, rollback, socket/callback and clone nonpublication gates are retained.

evidence.concurrency_fixture: 4 reader/destructor threads and 2 concurrent publishers; immutable child leases, clone destruction, shutdown/reopen and cached/physical root order; 80ms native lock wait excluded from a 30ms CPU budget, then cancellation before mutation.

tsan_test_model.reason: LLVM 22 defers asynchronous user handlers through ProcessPendingSignalsImpl on an ordinary stack; actual alternate-stack address cannot be asserted there. Instrumented test verifies SA_ONSTACK policy, while native test verifies actual alternate-stack use. No production signal logic or accuracy thresholds were changed.
tsan_test_model.port_lifetime: Measures exactly one owned-right decrement while holding an independent probe right; does not assume instrumentation retains no additional thread rights.

measurement_limits: Serial warm 10000-record point operations and 128-byte values. Relative matched fixture on shared hosts, no idle-host absolute claim. Linux candidate records host load ~3.09/3.74/4.10 before/after. Direct/facade psitri updates retain immutable snapshots and are still slower than mutable legacy triedent updates; application throughput remains a separate gate.
release_blocker: Pinned SAL flush errors can still be logged/ignored. Isolated maintained-library fail-stop correction and ordinary I/O fault regression matrix are in progress; no stable storage tag until corrected pin and requalification.
